parties:
Polish Ocean Lines, and another’s ------ Appellants.
VS
Al-Amin Seatrans Ltd. and others ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 3. The defendant Nos. 1 and 2 entered their appearance in the suit and contested the suit by filing written statement. It has been stated by the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 in the written statement that the suit is not maintainable in its present form and that the suit is barred by limitation as well as by the principles of estoppel, waiver and acquiescence and that the suit is bad for non-joinder, misjoinder of parties and multifariousness and that the plaintiff has got no locus-standi to file the present suit as against these defendants and that the plaintiff has got no cause of action for the suit as against these defendants and that the suit being misconceived, misleading and harassing is liable to be dismissed.
